purpose: Lets the person write free-form text that runs over one line, such as a message, a description or notes. Labels, hints and errors come from Field.

notFor.case: A short single-line value such as a name or email.
Several separate values entered as tags.

Default.visual: Surface/input box with a Border/control edge; text in Content/primary, placeholder and grip in Content/subtle.

Focused.visual: Border/focus edge with a Border/ring/default halo.

Invalid.visual: Status/critical/border-strong edge with a Status/critical/border halo; a warning glyph in Status/critical/content in the top-right corner.

Loading.meaning: Work on the value is running (aria-busy).
Loading.visual: The Default look with a spinner in Content/subtle in the top-right corner.

Disabled.visual: Action/disabled/default fill; text, placeholder and grip in Content/disabled.

a11y.keyboard: Tab reaches it; typing edits it and Enter adds a line.
notes: Give it a visible label (Field, or aria-label).
On Invalid set aria-invalid and expose the error text through aria-describedby (Field does both).

openQuestions: Resize: the resize glyph drags the box taller with a pointer. Should there be a keyboard way to resize, or is auto-growing the answer?
Loading: may the person keep typing while Loading, or is the field read-only then?
